crossRefs.note: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…

translations.web: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
translations.bsb: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
translations.kjv: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help
translations.asv: But be not thou far off, O Jehovah: O thou my succor, haste thee to help me.
